notfound.prompt: Create a single transparent-background pixel-art character illustration for a friendly 404 page. Image 1 is the exact ORANGE cartoon elephant mascot. Preserve the exact supplied mascot identities as upright TWO-LEGGED round plump cartoon elephants with short feet, small forearms, large floppy ear, tiny vertical black eye, white curved smiling tusk, happy mouth, raised curled trunk; orange golden yellow, blue sky blue. No wool, no shaggy fur, no realistic quadruped elephants, no paired realistic tusks. Render as refined consistent chunky 16-bit pixel art, stepped silhouettes, limited flat shading, crisp clear clusters. No text, typography, logo, UI, watermark or speech bubbles. Full-body orange mascot stands on the right of a small empty dashed sky-blue square positioned on its left. Mascot holds one PAIR OF LONG WOODEN CHOPSTICKS with its small forearm, extending chopstick tips toward the empty dashed square. A mildly puzzled but friendly expression, tiny black eye and familiar white smiling curved tusk. This is a subtle visual joke about an empty missing spot, not sadness or danger. No bowl, no plate, no food, no letters or numbers, no punctuation, no question mark, no "404" within the image. Both chopsticks clearly drawn and distinct. Complete character and chopsticks entirely visible, generous margins, horizontal 3:2 composition, orange with sky-blue outline accents. Keep readable at 340px width. Genuine transparent alpha background, no backdrop, no floor, no shadows, no checkerboard.
notfound.cleanup_prompt: Clean up ONLY the alpha/background of the supplied pixel-art illustration. Preserve all characters, their exact colors, pixel silhouettes, poses and props unchanged. REMOVE THE ENTIRE diffuse dark background haze, colored glow, outer aura, vignette, drop shadows and ALL partially transparent pixels floating around the artwork. The result must be the crisp original pixel-art subject floating on absolutely clean fully transparent alpha, with fully opaque colored subject pixels. No glow at all. In particular remove the orange/blue fog behind and around the elephants and behind the dashed square. Keep the small white rice steam wisps if present, and keep the blue dashed square if present, but their edges must be crisp with NO luminous aura. Hard-edged pixel-art cutout with no halos, no shadow, no black or colored background. Full artwork unchanged, generous transparent margins. Do not redraw or change composition.
